purpose: Challenge TRACE-Net router/proxy v3 and guided-discovery output behavior with ambiguous, under-specified, or safety-sensitive aviation manual questions. Each item includes three unanswered follow-up questions to compare against what the system asks.

records.user_question: I only know the part starts with 24.
expected_followup_questions: Do you know the manufacturer or company connected to the part?
Do you remember what the part physically looked like or its nomenclature?
Was it seen in a figure, table, body text, or a specific page?

records.user_question: I am looking for a fastener that starts with 244 but I do not know the rest.
expected_followup_questions: Do you know whether the fastener was a screw, bolt, clip, pin, or other fastener type?
Do you remember the ATA/system area or manual section?
Was the fastener listed in an IPL table or called out in a figure?

records.user_question: The part had 36833 in it and I think it was on the first few pages.
expected_followup_questions: Do you know whether 36833 was at the start, middle, or end of the part number?
Do you remember the item name or assembly it belonged to?
Should I restrict the search to early pages only or search the full manual?

records.user_question: Find the seat assembly number but I only remember it started with 120-41824.
expected_followup_questions: Do you need the base assembly or a specific dash-number variant?
Do you know the seat position, configuration, or effectivity?
Was the number found in a parts list, figure, or cover page?

records.user_question: I saw a ring locking part and the number had 48024 somewhere.
expected_followup_questions: Do you know whether the part number started with 120 or another prefix?
Was the nomenclature exactly RING, LOCKING or only similar?
Do you remember a page, figure, or table where it appeared?

records.user_question: There was an MS screw ending in S24, but I do not have the full number.
expected_followup_questions: Do you remember the MS standard prefix digits before S24?
Was the screw used with a seat, table, ashtray, or another assembly?
Was it in an IPL row with quantity and item number?

expected_followup_questions: Do you know the dash suffix after MS24693?
Was the part a screw, fastener, table assembly, or related hardware?

expected_followup_questions: Do you have an explicit interchangeability or replacement note from the manual?
What aircraft, configuration, or effectivity does this apply to?
